def add_months(day: str, n: int) -> str:
    from calendar import monthrange
    
    # Parse the input date
    year, month, day_of_month = map(int, day.split('-'))
    
    # Calculate the new month and year
    total_months = year * 12 + month + n
    new_year = (total_months - 1) // 12
    new_month = (total_months - 1) % 12 + 1
    
    # Get the last day of the original month
    _, last_day_of_original_month = monthrange(year, month)
    
    # Get the last day of the target month
    _, last_day_of_target_month = monthrange(new_year, new_month)
    
    # Apply billing rule: if original day was the last day of its month,
    # use the last day of target month. Otherwise, use the same day or
    # the last day of target month if it's too short.
    if day_of_month == last_day_of_original_month:
        new_day_of_month = last_day_of_target_month
    else:
        new_day_of_month = min(day_of_month, last_day_of_target_month)
    
    return f"{new_year:04d}-{new_month:02d}-{new_day_of_month:02d}"
